_readme: ONE COMPANY, ACROSS EVERY ENTERPRISE SCREENSHOT (EE-146).
Before this file the shot fixtures described three different companies.
units_ had Muhasebe/Saha Servis/Ar-Ge, sla_dashboard_ had Bakim(186)/
Muhendislik(92)/Elektrik(36), services_ had Bakim(9)/Bilgi Islem(5)/IK(3) —
two of them disagreed about how many people are in Bakim, and both of those
pictures are on the same marketing page. The two that DID agree only agreed
because a ticket subject was a copy-pasted string literal in two files.
WHAT IS TRANSLATED AND WHAT IS NOT. Structure is invariant across locales:
ids, counts, dates, brand colour, subdomain, and every person's name. Names
stay Turkish in both because Assignee.initials and colorRgb are drawn onto
the queue rows — translating a name changes the avatar, and the two
language versions would stop being pictures of the same screen. Unit names,
service names, custom-field labels and ticket subjects DO translate: they
describe what the product is, and an English buyer reading Turkish unit
names concludes the product is not translated, when in fact all 634 ee.*
keys exist in both.
NO COMPLIANCE NUMBER IS AUTHORED HERE. demo_corpus.dart derives it from
bySla, so the figure on the dashboard cannot drift from the buckets that
produce it. That is the exact defect this file replaces: compliance was
typed as 78.4 beside a two-row breach list, and 78.4% over 246 judged
requests means about 54 breaches, which the screen would have drawn in
full because _Breaches truncates nothing.
demo_corpus_test.dart runs WITHOUT the screenshots dart-define, so these
invariants are checked by the ordinary CI suite.

services._why: Routed to NOBODY on purpose. tickets/db.js refuses a request for an unrouted service (TICKET_SERVICE_UNROUTED) — 'a service nobody answers cannot receive anything' — so this one must name ZERO tickets on every axis. demo_corpus_test.dart asserts that, which is how the picture and the server's rule stay the same rule.

_why: A PERIOD, NOT A LIFETIME. 47 requests in a month for one service desk is
an ordinary number; the earlier fixture claimed 314 with a two-row breach
list, and _Breaches draws every row it is given, so the two could not both
be true. A small honest period is also the only shape in which the breach
list FITS the 900x1100 frame the shot is taken at.
Counts are keyed by id and the labels are resolved per locale, so the two
language versions quote identical figures by construction. The empty key
is the retired-catalogue-entry bucket: a null LABEL whose count is still
true, which sla_dashboard_models.dart documents as a real case.

links._why: The two that are easy to draw wrong: expired must read as ordinary, revoked must carry no controls.
